EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner when its access extension is approved (Partner Portal Setting: Extension Approved Email Template): the new access end date.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Access Extended
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties Partner Portal access has been extended
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
Your request to extend the Partner Portal access of {!Account.Name} has been approved. Your access now runs until {!Account.Temporary_Access_End_Date__c}.
NEXT STEP You can log in to the Partner Portal as usual.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
